title: 1.3 Two People: They and Are
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Connect two people with and, replace them with they, and use are while adding running, sitting, swimming, and sleeping.
grammar_function: Person and person + are + action; They are + action.
prerequisite: Lessons 1.1-1.2: people, he/she, is, the, and familiar actions.
speaking_outcome: Describe one or two people with is or are.
